style: Very simple pen line drawing, like a quick sketch by a 19th-century French book illustrator: a few clean continuous black ink strokes, minimal contour sketch, outlines only, no hatching, no cross-hatching, no shading, no tone, lots of white space, plain white background, no people, no human figures, an empty scene with no person at all, no hands, no crowd, no border, no frame, no rectangle, no text, no letters, no numbers, no signature, no flag, no insignia. Objects, buildings and settings of France between 1871 and 1900.
